/* Human Infra 项目首页和 Portal 页面；不改变普通词条的阅读排版。 */
.hi-mainpage,
.hi-portal {
  max-width: 1240px;
  margin: 0 auto;
}

.hi-mainpage-header {
  margin-bottom: 1rem;
  padding: 1.25rem 1.5rem;
  border: 1px solid #a2a9b1;
  background: #f8f9fa;
}

.hi-mainpage-header h1 {
  margin: 0 0 0.35rem;
  border: 0;
  font-size: 2rem;
}

.hi-mainpage-header p {
  margin: 0.35rem 0;
}

.hi-mainpage-nav {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 0.5rem 1rem;
  margin-top: 0.8rem;
  padding-top: 0.8rem;
  border-top: 1px solid #c8ccd1;
}

.hi-mainpage-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1fr);
  gap: 1rem;
}

.hi-mainpage-panel {
  min-width: 0;
  border: 1px solid #a2a9b1;
  background: #fff;
}

.hi-mainpage-panel > h2 {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0.55rem 0.8rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #a2a9b1;
  font-family: sans-serif;
  font-size: 1.05rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  background: #eaecf0;
}

.hi-mainpage-panel-body {
  padding: 0.75rem 1rem;
}

.hi-mainpage-panel-body > :first-child {
  margin-top: 0;
}

.hi-mainpage-panel-body > :last-child {
  margin-bottom: 0;
}

.hi-mainpage-wide {
  grid-column: 1 / -1;
}

.hi-mainpage-notice {
  margin-top: 1rem;
  padding: 0.8rem 1rem;
  border: 1px solid #a2a9b1;
  border-left: 4px solid #36c;
  background: #f8f9fa;
}

.hi-portal-lead {
  margin-bottom: 1rem;
  padding: 1rem 1.2rem;
  border: 1px solid #a2a9b1;
  background: #f8f9fa;
}

.hi-portal-links {
  columns: 2 22rem;
  column-gap: 2rem;
}

.hi-portal-links li {
  break-inside: avoid;
}

@media (max-width: 850px) {
  .hi-mainpage-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .hi-mainpage-wide {
    grid-column: auto;
  }
}
